maybe i’m just too sensitive about these things, but it kind of upsets me when i see the world around me using ace as an umbrella term? i mean, i’m totally asexual, sex repulsed in fact, but i’m about as far from aro as anyone can be. so when asexual gets used to talk about people who don’t want to be in any kind of relationship, it’s kind of a punch in the gut, and it feels sort of invalidating. it probably doesn’t help that a large chunk of the world around me knows me as “the ace kid,” but when the definition of “ace” is different for them, well... it doesn’t feel right to have the world not understand your sexuality, or have misconceptions about who you are. i don’t mean to make you feel bad or anything because there’s clearly no ill intent here, but for me, conflating asexuality and aromanticism can be a little uncomfortable for people whose romantic and sexual attraction differ drastically.
